---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Describe the task and the part of the current workflow that blocks it

## Task / 使用场景

What do you need to accomplish, and how often?

## Current friction / 当前困难

Which step blocks you? Include the interface you use: web, CLI or MCP.

## Proposed change / 建议

What result would make this task easier? Mention alternative tools or workflows you tried.
